ai.provider(s): Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint via raw fetch (no vendor SDK). Presets: nvidia (NIM, https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1), velocity (https://chat.velocity.online/api/v1), deepseek (https://api.deepseek.com/v1), gemini (OpenAI-compat https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai). Chosen by LLM_PROVIDER or explicit LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_MODEL; optional LLM_BACKUP_PROVIDER as a second failure domain.
models: openai/gpt-oss-20b (nvidia preset main + fast; model used in all evals)
gemini-3.8-flash main, gemini-3.1-flash-lite fallback/fast (gemini; marked unverified in code)
ai.orchestrator: agentOrchestrator composes A1 Concierge (read-only; native tool calling through a bounded toolLoop with allowlisted tools, each authorized with the caller's tRPC context) + write agents A2 Task Planner, A3 Notes Vault, A4 Events Publisher, A5 Org Admin, A6 Project Manager, plus taskGeneration. A1 returns JSON with intent type answer|handoff|clarify|draft_plan; handoff.ts runs up to 3 sub-agents concurrently in the same request. Write agents produce zod-validated JSON plans (JSON repair via fast model) -> draft (plan hash + confirmation token) -> confirm -> apply, with before-image undo and optional auto-apply of small plans. Rolling conversation summary, reply-language rules, reasoning-effort control, stable system prompt for provider caching, primary->fallback->backup-provider model chain.
ai.rag_or_embeddings: pgvector halfvec(2048) embedding columns on tasks, sticky_notes, document_chunks with HNSW halfvec_cosine_ops indexes (migration 0049; created by raw SQL, intentionally not in the drizzle schema). Hybrid search: vector + Postgres full-text (to_tsvector 'simple' GIN) merged with reciprocal rank fusion. Embeddings via OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint. Backfill script db:embed.
ai.rate_limit: Per-user 24h sliding window with plan ceiling (Free 15/day, Pro 200/day; AI_RATE_LIMIT env default); Redis-backed when configured.
ai.evals: 55-case A1 routing golden set (tests/agents/evals/cases.ts). Live run 2026-09-25 with gpt-oss-20b: routing accuracy 72.7% (40/55), schema validity 96.4% first pass / 98.2% after repair, tool selection 76.5% (13/17), tool-argument validity 70.6%. Persona 'Desi' eval 2026-10-17 (17 A1 + 2 A2 + 3 A4 scenarios, 2 runs): 2 of 9 criteria pass fully (C3 routing ~94%, C8), 1 partly (C4).

security.validation: zod input schemas on tRPC procedures and LLM outputs; env validated with @t3-oss/env-nextjs + zod (src/env.js)
security.rate_limiting: Sliding-window limiter (Redis-backed when REDIS_NATIVE_URL set, else in-memory): AI 24h window per plan; auth 5 attempts / 15 min; separate system AI limit (AI_SYSTEM_RATE_LIMIT)
security.csrf/headers: Security headers on every response via proxy: X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy (enforced by default; report-only via CSP_REPORT_ONLY). OAuth state check; Google Calendar connect uses signed state.
security.other: WS tickets HMAC-SHA256 short-lived; internal scheduler endpoint secret compared with timingSafeEqual; Stripe webhook signature verification; per-tool authorization in AI tool loop; prompt-injection scope guard covered by evals

realtime.description: Standalone Socket.IO 4.8 server process (ws-server/index.ts; `pnpm ws:dev`) separate from the Next.js custom HTTP server (server.ts). Clients authenticate with an HMAC-signed short-lived ticket from GET /api/ws/token sent in the Socket.IO auth frame. Rooms for events, orgs, projects and conversations; membership verified against the DB on join. Presence tracking and typing indicators. The Next.js app emits through Redis pub/sub (REDIS_NATIVE_URL, optional @socket.io/redis-adapter) or an HTTP internal-emit fallback in dev. ws-server also hosts the scheduler that periodically POSTs /api/internal/ai/run-schedules. Health endpoint.
